recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No follow-up source work is recommended for FHIR-12422 unless FM separately decides to revise the Claim/EOB sequence-link pattern in a future issue.
issue_request: FHIR-12422 is a Published/Persuasive Financial Management change request raised against DSTU2 asking to add procedureLinkId to Claim.item and ExplanationOfBenefit.item.
initial_application: The available git history does not show a commit that explicitly names FHIR-12422, but commit 37303c8e87f010b309f155116763f10165ef6d3f added Claim.item.procedureLinkId and ExplanationOfBenefit.item.procedureLinkId rows to the old financial-resource spreadsheet sources. Later R3-to-R4 mapping commits recorded the transition from those old names to Claim.item.procedureSequence and ExplanationOfBenefit.item.procedureSequence.
additional_context: Claim and ExplanationOfBenefit are active resources in source/fhir.ini. Their current authoritative StructureDefinition sources define Claim.item.procedureSequence and ExplanationOfBenefit.item.procedureSequence as 0..* positiveInt links to applicable procedures, and source/fhir.ini maps the old procedureLinkId names to these elements. FHIR-37513 later requested replacing Claim-related sequence properties with Element.id and was resolved Not Persuasive, supporting continued use of the sequence pattern.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. No source change was made because adding procedureLinkId back to the current resources would duplicate the current procedureSequence elements under obsolete names.

related_jiras.note: Later FM No Change decision retained the Claim-related sequence property pattern instead of replacing it with Element.id.
